poster_title: DataGovBench : Benchmarking LLM Agents for Real-World Data Governance Workflows
authors: Zhou Liu, Zhaoyang Han, Guochen Yan, Hao Liang, Wentao Zhang, Bohan Zeng, Xing Chen, Yuanfeng Song
paper_info: Peking University, China and ByteDance, China; 2025

panels.headline: Data governance is crucial for modern AI development, yet current tasks are manual and error-prone.
content: Data governance ensures data quality, security, and compliance.
Modern AI development relies heavily on robust data governance.
Manual data governance tasks are time-consuming and error-prone.
Existing benchmarks do not capture the unique challenges of data governance.
Automated data science benchmarks focus on snippet-level coding or high-level analytics.

panels.headline: Current LLMs and general-purpose agent frameworks struggle with complex, multi-step workflows.
content: Complex, multi-step workflows are challenging for current LLMs.
General-purpose agent frameworks lack robust error-correction mechanisms.
Real-world data governance tasks require specialized benchmarks.
DataGovbench aims to fill this gap with 150 realistic tasks.

panels.headline: DataGovAgent framework with Planner-Executor-Evaluator architecture.
content: DataGovbench: 150 real-world data governance tasks covering six scenarios.
Reversed-objective methodology for realistic noise synthesis and evaluation.
DataGovAgent: Constraint-based planning, retrieval-augmented code generation, and feedback-driven debugging.
panels.figure_caption: Illustration of the semi-automated pipeline designed for building DataGovbench.

panels.headline: DataGovAgent significantly improved Average Task Score (ATS) from 39.7 to 54.9.
content: Evaluated DataGovAgent on DataGovbench-150.
Compared with SOTA LLMs and general-purpose agent frameworks.
Reduced Average Debug Iterations (ADI) by over 77.9% compared to ChatDev.
panels.figure_caption: Comparison of Task Success Rate (TSR) across agents, base models, and task levels.

panels.headline: DataGovAgent demonstrates significant improvements in task success and efficiency.
content: DataGovAgent outperformed SOTA LLMs in complex tasks.
The framework's specialized design is crucial for data governance workflows.
Error-correction mechanisms significantly reduce debugging iterations.
DataGovbench provides a comprehensive and realistic benchmark.
panels.figure_caption: Comparison of Average Task Score (ATS) across agents, base models, and task levels.

panels.headline: DataGovbench and DataGovAgent highlight the potential of specialized frameworks in data governance.
content: DataGovbench offers a realistic benchmark for evaluating LLM-based data governance agents.
DataGovAgent shows significant improvements in task success and efficiency.
Specialized frameworks are essential for addressing complex data governance challenges.
Future work will focus on improving instruction decomposition and multi-step pipeline generation.
